mentions.name: Sub-20nm vacuum-tolerant positioning stage
mentions.description: A simplified, inexpensive positioning stage accurate to under 20 nanometers and tolerant of vacuum, built for microscopy and lithography projects and designed so other hobbyists can replicate the work with accessible tools and budgets.
mentions.problem: Nanometer-precision positioning normally requires expensive equipment; this design keeps the tools and budgets needed to replicate the work accessible for hobbyists.
mentions.audience: Precision positioning for microscopy and lithography projects
mentions.source_excerpt: Building a simplified inexpensive <20 nanometer accurate vacuum-tolerant positioning stage for microscopy and lithography projects.  Trying to unlock the caveman achievement by keeping tools/budgets necessary to replicate the work accessible for other hobbyists.

evidence.value: Building a simplified inexpensive <20 nanometer accurate vacuum-tolerant positioning stage for microscopy and lithography projects.  Trying to unlock the caveman achievement by keeping tools/budgets necessary to replicate the work accessible for other hobbyists.
